messages:
Emilia (CEO): Thanks for the questions during today's all-hands. Threading the reliability follow-ups here so leadership/Q&A stays visible. RCA link: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-ingress-throttle. Please post any clarifying questions or confirm action ownership.

Sam (VP Eng): Short recap: ~35m intermittent latency increase traced to an autoscaler policy flip + a cache TTL override introduced during a model config rollout. Mitigation: manual scale + rollback of the quantized config.

Rohit (SRE Lead): I've uploaded the RCA draft. Missing one cache log segment that shows the TTL override; attaching that by EOD. Added alert infra:cache-ttl-drift to catch regressions.

Priya (Runtime eng): Rollback in progress. Using the gated change window at 02:00 UTC to flip --enable_quant to false across regions. PR: rollback-config-pr-522. Will report when merged.

Jess (Customer Ops): I'll draft a short customer-facing note and compile the impacted accounts spreadsheet. Draft ETA: EOD tomorrow. Posting link once ready. Who needs to approve? Legal + Sam?

Tara (Product): Product will classify impacted customers into severity buckets and add a "deploy safety checklist" item to the roadmap. Will sync with Engineering on the criteria.

Diego (Oncall): Oncall running a 48h canary with extra tail-latency instrumentation. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary. First 6h look good; will post 24h snapshot.

Lina (Docs): I'll prepare a short "one-pager" for onboarding: what happened, key mitigations, and checklist for safe rollouts. ETA next sprint.

ops-bot (deploy-bot): Deploy: rollback-config-pr-522 merged by @Priya at 2026-03-28T02:14Z

Sam (VP Eng): Action items recap: 1) Rohit: attach missing logs + finalize RCA by 2026-03-30 2) Priya: complete rollback + gate flag behind feature-flag by 2026-04-02 3) Jess: customer comms draft by 2026-03-29 EOD 4) Tara/Product: severity mapping + checklist 5) Diego/Oncall: finish 48h canary and share telemetry. Please react when you complete your item.

Rohit (SRE Lead): Note for engineers: grep to find TTL override traces: kubectl logs -l app=ingress-cache -n prod | grep -n "ttl_override" -C2

Jess (Customer Ops): Draft posted: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/ingress-comm-draft - feedback welcome.

Priya (Runtime eng): Rollback confirmed merged. Night window went clean. Following up to gate the flag.

Diego (Oncall): Canary complete: 48h stable. Posting final dashboard snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary?view=48h

Sam (VP Eng): Thanks. Finance/Support: ping if you need the impacted list earlier. We'll add deploy gating checks to the deploy-bot so this doesn't recur.

Emilia (CEO): Appreciate the fast cross-team coordination. Please keep updates in this thread — it's the canonical place for questions/leadership answers. React with :white_check_mark: when you've completed action items so we can close them.

Rohit (SRE Lead): attaching missing log snippet now and updating RCA link.

Jess (Customer Ops): acked :+1:

Priya (Runtime eng): ack :gear:

Diego (Oncall): canary metrics posted.

Sam (VP Eng): I'll ping owners in 48h for short status notes and then close the action list.
